title: SQLite and DuckDB: a bigger share in the latest year
author: story-finder
question: Are SQLite and DuckDB a bigger share of Hacker News stories than before?
hypothesis: SQLite and DuckDB titles are a bigger share of stories in the latest 12 months than before.
expect: Share of stories in the latest 12 months divided by the pooled share of all earlier stories since 2006: 1.25x or more supports (1.5x or more is strong); 0.8x or less refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

check.per_label: SQLite and DuckDB share of stories

caveats: Only story titles are matched, so stories that discuss SQLite or DuckDB without naming them are missed, and a title that names one is not proof the story is about it.
The term was picked because its numbers stood out, so this card tests it on the current data and is not a prediction.
The latest 12 months are compared with the pooled share of every earlier story since 2006, so a long quiet past lowers the bar.
